name: Colombian police officer, 1993 (generic)
depiction: Generic police officer of the 1990s in a plain olive-green uniform shirt, dark green trousers and a green peaked cap, standing in for the Search Bloc officers. No badge, patch, crest, name tag, unit insignia or flag of any real force is drawn, and no weapon is ever shown (the 'torch' pose carries a flashlight). Not a likeness of any real officer; no real officer is named.
